title: bromus madritensis var. maximus
intro: Bromus madritensis var. maximus, commonly known as Spanish hard grass, is a perennial grass species native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bromus madritensis var. maximus include reducing inflammation, fighting infections, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
